name: Phenon
title: Chieftain of Edom
summary: Phenon was one of the tribal chieftains (allufim) in Edom, a descendant of Esau. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the chieftains of Edom. He represents one of the clans that made up the Edomite people in the southern Canaan region.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the chieftains of Edom
keyEvents.description: Phainon is listed as one of the tribal chiefs descended from Esau in the land of Edom. The list shows the various clans that made up the Edomite people.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Phainon is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles in the enumeration of Edom's chiefs, confirming his place in Edom's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: Esau's lineage and the origin of Edom
keyEvents.description: Phainon belonged to the broader context of Esau's descendants who settled in the mountains of Seir and formed the nation of Edom.

keyEvents.title: The chiefdom system of Edom
keyEvents.description: Phainon was part of a chiefdom system where each tribal leader represented a clan or territory within Edom, an early form of political organization.
